methods.name: MS2LandsNet
methods.summary: A lightweight CNN for landslide detection consisting of three down-sampling stages with multi-scale feature fusion (MFF) and multi-scale channel attention (MSCA) to aggregate contextual features while reducing parameters.
methods.source: Wei Lu, Yunfeng Hu, Wei Shao, Hao Wang, Zuopei Zhang & Mingyan Wang

availability.author_statement: Data and code availability statement, with shared links. Algorithm and weights for the CNN model not found.

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense dataset is linked and publicly available, while Sentinel-2 and NASADEM are accessible via Google Earth Engine; however, the GF-2 imagery is commercial and lacks a clear path to access. Custom code for data acquisition and pre-processing is provided via persistent Google Drive links, but the model algorithm and weights are not available.
